annotations.text: The 741px disc is clipped to a 390x329 box. A circle clipped to a rectangle is a rectangle — that is the square you are seeing.
No wrapper, no clip. The disc runs off three sides of the screen the way a big circle does, and the dock finally has something passing behind it.
The wheel stays as the background — receded, blurred, half opacity. The sheet is the first glass in the app with real content behind it.
The diagnosis. Glass is not a colour you apply, it is a relationship with what is behind it — which is why every surface in the app looked like a paler rounded rectangle.
